data.why: the repo ships a built-in 300-row example Excel loadable via a sidebar button, and the same file can be handed to the browser as an upload-test file since the uploader also accepts .xlsx

goals: load a clinical study dataset and clean/diagnose its structure (column types, missing patterns, merged headers)
run descriptive statistics and normality checks on key variables
run inferential tests (group comparisons, paired comparisons, correlation, diagnostic agreement) between study groups
fit a predictive model (logistic or Cox regression) and evaluate it with ROC/calibration/decision curves
run causal inference analyses such as propensity score matching or subgroup forest plots
export a one-click Word analysis report summarizing methods, tables and figures

review.summary: The tree follows MedBench's stated chain from cleaning through causal inference to Word export, with well-sized tasks and features, and the 12 screens I opened match their nodes apart from a small error in the t20 file size. Before filing, it needs the data-structure cleaning work and Table 1 added, the QC phase recast as a parallel use, and the unverified download and the non-working jump button corrected.
